content:
Frustrations about impending failure. Advice requested (long post)
On year 6 of my own business and it feels like everything is falling apart. Lets break it down some, but before we do, please note, this will be very rant-y and is coming from probably not the best place.. but I am trying

Started my company in Jan of 2015. Quickly amassed over 40k in debt that it took until 2018 to pay off. Will never rent space in a mall again, this business is clearly not retain oriented. 

The business is a product development, service based business, so like many it suffered hard in covid. To compound. I took a day job right at the tail end of 2019. Unfortunately I suffered 2 herniated discs that completely ruin my productivity because of the pain, numbness, etc. We cleared 54k in sales and 13k net profit in 2020, however I did not pay myself, I never have. Now in 2021, my body is not getting better, and due to that it is a work comp case it is also out of my hands how fast it gets better. 

Because of my injury I have tried to bring on contractors to help and when we think we found THE ANSWER something always seems to happen. Our latest guy, for example, now has pneumonia. A buddy of mine put it in a way that I think best describes what is going on.. We are circling the drain trying to get momentum but every time we try and launch out we get shoved back in. 

Lets list out some issues:

-1099's, no W2's because we cannot afford them

-Talent is pretty young, but we cant afford hardened talent

-Business is negative 2k+ for the year already

-One of our key people is very sick and unresponsive

-My back is causing me so many issues including the inability to get a good nights sleep

-Our branding guy took on a huge job with Verizon meaning he has all but forgotten about us, so all the work he was doing on the site, social media, etc. is now incredibly limited. He is working, but instead of 10-20 hours a week it may be 3 now. 

-Have been denied PPP and EIDL constantly, even this round specifically for small businesses because I did not pay myself last year, we could not afford it. 

And quite frankly I am not sure I am up to the task of it all. We have accomplished so much, the entire team, but it simply has not resulted in anything tangible. Our industry is relatively new (3D printing) and we are working on getting a LMS running for it, but I have to be very conscious of the time I put into it vs. the time I put to literally everything else. 

I know I am running incredibly thin, and honestly not sure what to do. My best instinct tells me I need a break, but my wallet says you need 10k in sales this month to even afford to put your head down to sleep at night. So I keep burning. 

I recognize this is going to end in a burnout, this is the common formula for me, and I am not entirely sure how to break it. 

Any suggestions here? We are working on a complete rebrand but because of my budget I have to wait sometimes. Alas, that time is money for me, however not enough to spend 25k+ to actually bring in a firm to do it. We have the new logo, the new identity, however the website is not done, and we are not really sticking to a marketing plan, no matter how hard I try. Marketing is NOT my strong suit. I can sell, but in a digital world, one where capital expenditures are low, this is something becoming more and more difficult. 

We hit the first page on google, we are on the map, but the phone never rings (other than spam). I want to run ads, but have no clue where to start. My skills are VERY specialized. I have looked into getting a c-suite team together, but that comes right back to finances not being there to afford such a thing. I am willing to invest in my future, we have liquid capital, but I am constantly afraid of making huge mistakes, mistakes that cost literally years of time. We lost 4 months of my life in the past 2 months if we look at our finances.. Time that is now even harder to come by because of my back. 

What have you guys done to get out of this seemingly bottomless pit of bullshit and grow your fucking business rather than being drowned by it? Because, shit, I feel like I am drowning, and we aint even busy.. If we fail I am letting so many people down in the process, with the largest being myself. I am not sure I can manage that kind of weight. 

I am willing to do whatever it takes to make this work. I am not sure who told me, but someone did.. when it feels like you are on the edge of a cliff, just jump. I feel like I am there, but I do not know how to jump, if that makes sense.. Any advice would be greatly appreciated.
